context: Asuka lectures on law and civic duty.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: civics lecture; vocabulary (法案/判決/議会/ボランティア/貢献) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 法案は、議会で審議されます。
lines.en: Bills are deliberated in the assembly.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 判決と法案は、関係しますか?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 判決が、新しい法案を生むこともあります。
lines.en: Rulings can give rise to new bills.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 市民の貢献も、大事ですか?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ボランティアの貢献が、社会を支えます。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 議会は、その声を聞くんですか?
lines.en: Does the assembly hear those voices?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、議会が市民の貢献を法案に反映します。
lines.en: Yes, the assembly reflects citizens' contributions in bills.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ボランティアの力、大きいんですね。
lines.style: moved adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
